feature: B2B Wholesale Customer Registration & Admin Approval Workflow

requirements.title: Successful B2B Registration Form Submission & Entity Creation
requirements.clause: As a new wholesale buyer, I want to register for a B2B wholesale account on /register by providing Company Info, Contact Details, Account Setup credentials, Trade License attachment, and mandatory Agreements, creating an inactive B2B customer mapped to an ERP Account.

requirements.title: Uniqueness Validation During Registration
requirements.clause: When entering an Email address or Username already registered in the system, submission is blocked with an explicit error message.

requirements.title: Admin Reviews Wholesale Application Details
requirements.clause: When an administrator views the customer's profile in /Admin, they can inspect custom wholesale application data (Type of Business, Contact Media, Position, Age Confirmation, Trade License).

requirements.title: Admin Approves and Activates B2B Account
requirements.clause: When an administrator checks the Active flag to approve the account and saves changes, the customer account becomes active and sends a welcome/activation email.

requirements.title: Password Mismatch & Field Format Validation
requirements.clause: When entering a Confirm Password that does not match Password or an invalid 10-digit/non-numeric BD mobile number, form submission is blocked with field-level error messages.

requirements.title: Dynamic Contact Channel Toggle & Field Clear Validation
requirements.clause: When toggling Preferred Contact Channel between Whatsapp and Messenger, relevant input fields are dynamically rendered and hidden channel values are cleared.
